description: This Java file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates a keyframe animation using AnimationDrawable. It constructs a frame-by-frame animation where each frame displays a gray background with a frame number, and allows toggling the animation on user tap.

classes.name: KeyframeAnimation
classes.description: An Android Activity that creates and controls a frame-based animation composed of images with text indicating frame numbers. It provides user interaction to start and stop the animation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the animation drawable with frames, and assigns click behavior to toggle the animation.

methods.name: getDrawableForFrameNumber
methods.description: Creates a Bitmap with a gray background and overlays text indicating the frame number, then returns it as a BitmapDrawable.
